mechanism: Cobicistat is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase zoledronic acid exposure through altered metabolism and renal clearance; both drugs can cause renal dysfunction independently, increasing nephrotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) before and regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider dosage adjustment of zoledronic acid if renal impairment develops.
